senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. סָלַל I, סלח)to bound, rebound, shrink.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 5:9">Makhsh. V, 9</cite> <he>מפני שהיא סוֹלֶדֶת לאחוריה</he> because the jet of a viscous mass, when poured out and stopped, bounds backward (and the connection with the mass in the unclean vessel is not suddenly severed, v. <cite ref="N00754"><he>נִיצּוֹק</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Gittin 57a:19">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>לובן ביצה סוֹלֵד מן האור</he> a stain on bed-clothes made by the white of an egg contracts (and hardens) when heated, opp. <cite ref="D00496"><he>דיהה</he></cite> gets faint.

<cite ref="Shabbat 40b:7">Sabb. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>יד סולדת בו</he> when the hand put into it is spontaneously withdrawn (feeling the scald); <cite ref="Chullin 105b">Ḥull. 105ᵇ</cite> top. Pesik. B’shall., p. 103ᵃ <he>ונפשו סולדת לאחוריה</he> his soul starts backward (he shrinks back in disgust of the smell); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51">Gen. R. s. 51</cite> <he>ונפשו ס׳ עליו</he>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 11">Midr. Till. to Ps. XI</cite> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <he>מסוללת</he>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 85">Yalk. Gen. 85</cite>; (<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 655">Yalk. Ps. 655</cite> <cite ref="S01789"><he>קצה</he></cite>).—Sifra Emor ch. II, Par. 3; <cite ref="Bekhorot 43b:18">Bekh. 43ᵇ</cite> <he>חוטמו סולד</he> one whose nose is turned up (snub-nosed).

senses.gloss: to spring, sport (euphem. for unnatural sexual gratification). Y. Gitt. VIII, 49ᶜ bot., v. סָלַל I.
